record.name: Comoros
record.summary: No qualifying institute or commitment identified. In March 2026 the government reported an AI-readiness assessment commission, examining national institutional, technical and regulatory capacity rather than the option of a safety institute.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.
Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. The presidential cabinet account commissions an assessment of national AI readiness, covering institutional, technical and regulatory capacity. This is a broad readiness study, not an institute-specific study under the dataset definition. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded fr query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The Lawyers Hub desk-research profile was read, but independence of its underlying citations from the paired national or press source was not verified. It is not counted as a second evidence origin. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: The presidency's Cabinet account describes an AI-readiness assessment commission examining national institutional, technical and regulatory capacity.

record.notes: An earlier exploratory Comorian/Swahili-related search produced no usable official result; its vocabulary was not validated as Shikomori and does not establish Shikomori-language coverage. Read the Presidency account of the 11 March 2026 Council of Ministers meeting (published 12 March), which says a six-month AI-readiness assessment had already begun and was expected to finish in June. No completion date or new institute is inferred. Its assessment of national readiness is not exploration of an AISI option under the tracker definition. Also read the Technopole project page https://technopole.km/projet_technopole, describing digital skills and startup support, without a qualifying evaluation mandate. ANADEN homepage retrieval and one attempt to retrieve a text copy failed. A reported September readiness report could not be located in a primary source; no claims from that lead are incorporated. The former blanket claim that no AI body was found is removed.

next_check.reason: Low policy footprint; re-check for any AI strategy.
